literal: a frog at the bottom of a well
meaning_long: someone with a very narrow view of the world
source: 《庄子·秋水》 (public domain), retold in our own words.
cover: He thought his well\Nwas the WHOLE world.
hook: He thought his well\Nwas the WHOLE world.
story: Ancient China. A little frog lives at the bottom of an old well. Looking up at the small circle of sky, he is sure his well is the best place in the world. One day a huge sea turtle passes by, and the frog proudly invites him in. The turtle cannot even fit one foot into the well. Then the turtle tells the frog about the sea: so vast that no flood can make it rise and no drought can make it fall. The frog is speechless.
continuity: - THE FROG: a small, round, bright-green frog with big golden eyes, a cheeky proud grin and a puffed-out chest; expressive like a comic character.
- THE SEA TURTLE: a huge, wise old sea turtle with a moss-green shell, kind droopy eyes, a few barnacles and a calm smile; much bigger than the well.
- THE WELL: an old round stone well in a quiet village courtyard, mossy stones inside, a little water at the bottom; from inside, only a small circle of sky is visible far above.
- SETTING: ancient China, soft daylight; the sea (in I7) is an endless calm ocean with soft grey ink-wash waves.
scenes: The twist (used as the hook, first frame of the video)

At the well in the courtyard: the huge sea turtle has tried to step into the well and one big flipper is stuck in the narrow well mouth, the turtle looking down puzzled and a little embarrassed; perched on the well rim, the tiny frog spreads his arms wide in proud welcome. Both faces clear. This is the most important image; the editor will push in on it.
Inside, at the bottom of the well: the frog lounges happily on a mossy stone in the shallow water, hands behind his head, very content. (Only the frog.)
Low view from the bottom of the well: the frog looks up at the small circle of blue sky far above, chest puffed out, very proud, as if it were the whole world. (Only the frog.)
In the courtyard outside the well: the huge sea turtle crawls slowly by and peers curiously over the well's stone rim. (Only the turtle.)
The frog jumps up onto the well rim, waving his arms and boasting, inviting the turtle in; the turtle looks at the tiny well, doubtful.
Close-ish: the turtle's huge flipper is jammed in the well mouth, a few stones creaking, the turtle smiling awkwardly; the frog stares at the flipper, shocked.

The turtle sits beside the well telling a story; above them, a dreamy ink-wash vision of an endless calm ocean stretching to the horizon fills the sky. The frog on the rim listens, jaw dropped, eyes huge.
The well (background for the big title)

The mossy stone rim of the well with a few water drops and one tiny lily pad on the ledge, in the lower half of the frame. The upper half is a calm, plain sky with soft grey ink washes and almost nothing in it (we place the big title there). No animals.

A tiny modern room: the same FROG wearing a small green hoodie stands on a tiny chair with his arms spread proudly, showing off his little room, while through the big window behind him a huge, bright city and the sea stretch to the horizon. No people. No text, no logos, no screens.
lines: He thought his little well was the whole world.
This frog lived at the bottom of an old well.
He looked up at a tiny circle of sky, so proud.
One day, a big sea turtle came by.
Come in! My home is the best in the world!
The turtle could not even fit one foot inside.
Then he told the frog about the endless sea.
A frog at the bottom of a well.
It means someone with a very narrow view.
Like thinking your hometown is the center of the world.
title: He thought his little well was the whole world 🐸 | 井底之蛙
desc: 井底之蛙 (jǐng dǐ zhī wā) = someone with a very narrow view of the world. Ever met one? 👇
pinned: 井 well · 底 bottom · 之 of · 蛙 frog. 📝 多出去看看，别做井底之蛙。(Duō chūqù kànkan, bié zuò jǐng dǐ zhī wā.) = Go out and see more; don't be a frog at the bottom of a well.
